name: base64-encoder-decoder-devops
description: Base64 Encoder/Decoder Web Application with complete DevOps CI/CD Pipeline

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); if (fs.existsSync('base64-encoder-decoder-build.zip')) fs.unlinkSync('base64-encoder-decoder-build.zip');"
scripts.build: npm run clean && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('src', 'dist', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build output created in ./dist');"
scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const zlib = require('zlib'); const path = require('path'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); console.log('Packaging dist files...'); execSync('powershell -Command \"Compress-Archive -Path dist/* -DestinationPath base64-encoder-decoder-build.zip -Force\"', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Created base64-encoder-decoder-build.zip');"
